Text Block or Text Table

Source: R/figure-plots-text.R
PlotTextBlock.Rd

A panel of text placed in its figure box: lines written from templates and data (statistic lines, headings that contain numbers, notes) or, with layout = "table", a small table of text cells as produced by PlotDataTableCells().

Usage

PlotTextBlock(
  data = NULL,
  template = NULL,
  text = NULL,
  size = NULL,
  colour = "muted",
  bold = FALSE,
  hjust = 0,
  vjust = 0,
  x = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  lineheight = 1.1,
  angle = 0,
  layout = c("lines", "table"),
  widths = NULL,
  header_fill = "#F3F3F3",
  highlight_fill = "#FFF2D6",
  border_colour = "#D9D9D9",
  border_linewidth = 0.4,
  key_colours = NULL,
  table_size = 5.5,
  first_pad = 0.02,
  borders = c("cells", "rules"),
  align = c("centre", "left"),
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

data

Optional data frame.

template

Optional templates.

text

Optional fixed lines (placed before the template lines).

size

Font size(s) in points; default the style's statistic size.

colour

Colour(s); style names allowed.

bold

Bold face per line.

hjust, vjust

Justification of the block.

x, y

Anchor in fractions of the box (default hjust, vjust).

lineheight

Line height multiplier.

angle

Rotation in degrees.

layout

"lines" or "table".

widths

Relative column widths of a table (default: first column 0.23, others equal).

header_fill, highlight_fill, border_colour

Table colours.

border_linewidth

Cell border width in points.

key_colours

Named colours for header text by key.

table_size

Table font size.

first_pad

Left padding of first-column text (fraction of width).

borders

"cells" (a frame around every cell, with fills) or "rules" (only horizontal rules between rows, no fills).

align

Alignment of the columns after the first: "centre" or "left" (at first_pad from the column edge).

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'grid' grob.

Details

Lines: text gives fixed lines; template is filled from data with FormatTemplate() (one template per data row, or one template for every row). size, colour and bold may be given per line. The block is anchored at x, y (fractions of the box) with hjust, vjust.

Table: cells with row, column, label, header, highlight and key columns; the first column is left aligned, the others centred; header cells are bold on header_fill and coloured by key through key_colours; highlighted cells use highlight_fill.

Examples

g <- PlotTextBlock(data.frame(k = 11, n = 12, p = 0.0015),
                   template = "{k|d}/{n|d} patients; p = {p|p}")
grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(g)
